about:
Captor Corporation was established in 1965 in Tipp City, Ohio, by an engineering-oriented management team that included several experienced veterans. The company built a dedicated manufacturing facility shortly after inception, which has since expanded to a 35,000-square-foot, state-of-the-art plant housing engineering, sales, and production under one roof.

The company designs and manufactures custom EMI filters, capacitors, inductors, coils, cable assemblies, wire harnesses, electromechanical assemblies, and power distribution units. Its in-house capabilities span engineering, custom capacitor winding, coil winding (toroid, bobbin-wound, tube-wound, C-core), cable and harness fabrication, box-build assembly, and environmental testing including altitude, humidity, thermal shock, vibration, and hermetic seal. Captor has produced over 10,000 custom filter designs and focuses on low- to medium-volume production.

Captor serves OEMs in aerospace, defense, military communications, secure communications (including SCIF and TEMPEST applications), medical equipment, telecommunications, radar systems, and missile launching systems. Its military-grade products meet MIL-STD-220, MIL-STD-461 CE102, and AS9100D requirements, and are used in air, sea, and ground applications.

The company positions itself as a leader in custom EMI filters, stating that its custom solutions are often delivered faster and at lower cost than competitors' off-the-shelf parts, with no added cost for customization. Its mission emphasizes highest-quality EMI filters, customer listening, a safe workplace, continuous improvement, and total customer satisfaction.
